charterSubtitle: CodeAlgo Academy partners with charter networks to bring engaging, standards-aligned computer science to every classroom.
charterStandardDesc: Our curriculum is fully aligned with state standards (TEKS, CCSS, B.E.S.T.) so you can seamlessly integrate it into your existing charter.
charterIntegrationDesc: Easily roster students with Clever or Google Classroom. No complex IT setup required for your teachers.
charterFundingDesc: We work with charter networks to provide cost-effective licensing that fits your school's budget.
charterHeading: A coding curriculum charter schools can actually staff and fund
charterBody: Charter schools ask more of a smaller staff, with tighter budgets than district schools. CodeAlgo was built to fit that reality — not adapted from an enterprise product after the fact.
charterHighlight1Desc: CodeAlgo maps to state CS standards, so coordinators can fund it through existing federal and state STEM budgets — no new grant cycle required.
charterHighlight2Desc: Runs in any browser on the Chromebooks your school already issues. A teacher can roll it out to a full roster in one class period.
charterHighlight3Desc: Charter cohorts often mix grades and skill levels in one room. Lessons place each student at their own starting point and pace automatically.
